$comment: FEED-131: the PRIMITIVE specimens of the web-parity gate (conformance/parity.ts, group `primitive`): `@exponential-at/ui-react/primitives` (Radix + dist/exponential-ui-react.css) = the reference, `@exponential-at/ui-solid/primitives` (+ dist/exponential-ui-solid.css, byte-identical) = the candidate. Each row runs × [exponential light, orange dark] through both harnesses' `?view=primitives&id=<id>&theme=&mode=&width=`; the specimen itself lives in harness/primitives/<primitive>.ts(x) of EACH package (SPECIMENS[id]). The whole <body> is compared (DOM incl. body attributes, every element's computed style + frame, pixels), 0 tolerance.

$fields.id: `<primitive>/<variant>`, unique; the harness key (SPECIMENS[id]) on both sides
$fields.primitive: the harness module that owns it: smoke | plain | controls | overlays | data | calendar
$fields.viewport: { width, height } of the page (width is also the `width` query)
$fields.open: true = an overlay opens on mount (the specimen passes defaultOpen); the gate waits for window.__xuiOverlay?.() !== null when the page defines it, then two frames
$fields.interact: null | "hover" | "focus": the gate also runs a case that hovers / focuses the FIRST [data-xui-target] inside the specimen on both sides, waits two frames, then dumps
